title: localfix: agent frank verification rules from mimi-protocol#159
description: For the agent's recipient-side franking checks (protocol-06 §5.4.1.3), per rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#159 (2026-10-19): in a franking-required room (frank_aad 0x0020 required), discard a message whose franking fields are absent or only partly present; compare the room ID as bytes and the sender URI by URI comparison rules (RFC 3986 §6; mimid: simple string comparison, §6.2.1, unless a decision says otherwise). Identity-to-domain mapping stays per decision (BasicCredential; draft-mahy-mimi-identity has no WG consensus). Implement when the agent's frank verification is built; cite #159.
